name: Gauge - Meeting Notes
description: Capture meeting captions + audio (on your Record click) and generate AI-powered sales notes.
_review_notes: PERMISSION storage: persists caption buffer + upload state locally (chrome.storage.local) so a closed tab never loses captions.
PERMISSION tabCapture: captures the meeting TAB audio stream ONLY after the user clicks Record in the side panel. Never auto-starts; stream is released on Stop.

PERMISSION offscreen: hosts the MediaRecorder (32kbps Opus) in an offscreen document because MV3 service workers die after ~30s and cannot hold a MediaStream. Created lazily on first Record click, closed on Stop.
PERMISSION sidePanel: hosts the recorder UI (paste Bearer key, Record/Stop/Send, recent calls).
PERMISSION alarms: retries the captions finalize POST after the service worker restarts (SW 30s death respected - no setTimeout chains).
HOST meet.google.com / teams.microsoft.com / *.zoom.us: meeting pages where caption scraping + tab audio capture run, and only there.
HOST https://usegauge.vercel.app/* (APP_ORIGIN in shared.js): Gauge API - /api/upload-url, /api/analyze, /api/v1/calls with Bearer cn_live_/cn_test_.
REMOVED vs 1.0.0: identity, activeTab, cookies dropped - auth is now a pasted Bearer key kept in chrome.storage.session (memory-only, never local).
